title: [Shopify] Handle missing variant mapping in product action
summary: The Show product in Shopify action on the Item Card and Item List is now enabled only when the item has a Shopify Variant linked through an enabled shop. If the variant mapping disappears before the action runs, users get clear guidance instead of a raw database filter error.
key_points: Action enabled only when item has a valid Shopify Variant linked through an enabled shop
Clear error guidance provided if variant mapping disappears between page rendering and action invocation
Same validation behavior applied to both Item Card and Item List pages
No schema or data changes; existing valid mappings unaffected
Regression tests added for the new validation logic
quote: The action only when the item has a Shopify Variant linked through an enabled shop.
